purpose: Golden Kog token watch by Kognai: one Solana or Base token watched for 24 hours after a baseline risk analysis, with alerts when its risk picture changes (liquidity pulled, top holders or the dev wallet selling, authorities or taxes changed), by webhook and on the job page. Use it to keep an eye on a token an agent holds or follows. Risk alerts only, never a buy or sell signal.

token.description: the token address: a Solana mint, or a Base contract (0x and 40 hex)

client_order.description: optional: your own order id (128 random bits or more); with it the reply comes as soon as the payment is verified and GET order_url reads the result

wait_s.description: optional: how long to hold the call open for the result, in seconds

webhook.description: optional: a public https url that receives the alerts

state.description: done (watching for a watch) when the report is ready; otherwise poll status_url

report.description: level (low, medium, high, severe or issuer), flags, unknown facts and the written text

examples.description: Unpaid call: HTTP 402 with the x402 terms (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and body).
Same call with the signed payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header).

flags.evidence: top 10 holders outside pools hold 24 percent

report.text: a short written reading of the facts

x-kognai.settlement: Base: verified at once, collected only when the report is delivered. Solana: settled up front; a failed job leaves a recorded refund owed.
